control_rule.K0_primary: K0B (PROXY_B, k_s=0) and K0C (PROXY_C, k_s=0): identical eps sha and raw outputs equal on valid joints within 1e-05 (normalised) -> Stage-1 content cannot reach the output by any other path; failure -> BLOCKED
control_rule.K0_secondary: K0B vs frozen W136 U raw output <= 0.0001 normalised and decoded wrist/elbow <= 1.0 mm: reported (WARNING, not BLOCKED, unless the primary pair also fails); x1 equality with W136's x1_known reported separately
control_rule.eps: every seed-10 run has the same eps sha; NREF (seed 11) eps sha differs and |corr(eps_NREF, eps_seed10)| < EPS_CORR_MAX = 0.03 on the 36,000 valid entries, else the native control is INVALID (reported; no reseed)
control_rule.noise_floor: S2B_rep: a separate-process replicate of S2B; max |S2B - S2B_rep| (normalised G entries; decoded wrist/elbow mm) is the floor
control_rule.sampler: per run: scheduled_sampler_calls == 1, generate_samples calls == 1, network forward calls == 100 (50 steps x CFG 2), per-state mask sha recorded; K1 (k_s=50 copy) is a synthetic test only
control_rule.x1: for every primary run x1_known_used is bit-equal to the official x1_known (no injection); S2A/S2B/S2C tensors are bit-equal on kept valid entries pairwise (BRIDGE_LEAK otherwise) and equal the offline float64-normalised bridge tensors within X1_OFFLINE_TOL = 1e-05 (float32 rounding); K0 primary additionally requires K0B/S2B/S2B_rep and K0C/S2C to receive identical x1 and K0C's x1 to differ from K0B's on G

information_rule.I1_visibility: implementation check on NON-DISCARDED evaluations only (the per-run recorded-state checks -- every state j<=K_S equals the scheduled interpolant on keep|G bit-exactly, j>K_S on keep -- are PREREQUISITES, failure = BLOCKED); the network input at Euler step K_S (first evaluation whose output is not overwritten on G) equals state K_S; cross-run state K_S difference equals t_s (x1_C - x1_B) on G within 1e-06 and 0 on kept valid entries; the input-layer token embeddings of step K_S differ on G cells and agree (<= 1e-5) elsewhere. Steps 0..K_S-1 are reported as computed-and-discarded and are never evidence.
information_rule.I2_learned_reading: gamma = <dx1hat_K_S, dx1>/|dx1|^2 on G (x1hat = x + (1-t) v, the network's own clean-data estimate at the first free evaluation) >= 0.75; passive state-blind null = t_s = 0.5, context-only regeneration ~0, perfect denoiser 1
information_rule.I3_network_response: network term N = dout - t_s dx1 on G with ||N|| >= 0.25 ||t_s dx1|| AND decoded (hybrid FK, PROXY_C context, world map C) max wrist/elbow |out_C - null_C| over Action 172..199 >= 10.0 mm AND >= 10.0 x the S2B/S2B_rep decoded noise floor AND ||N|| >= 10 x feature noise floor x sqrt(|G|); null_C = out_B + t_s (x1_C - x1_B) on G
information_rule.learned_path: I1 AND I2 AND I3; direction reported as AMPLIFIES / WASHES_OUT / ORTHOGONAL from cos(N, dx1) (+-0.1)
information_rule.reported_not_ruled: beta = <dout, dx1>/|dx1|^2 (passive null 0.5), gamma at steps K_S+5, 40, 49; the same decomposition for A vs B; Stage-1 content split into MotionBricks endpoint-correction ramp vs uncorrected remainder (preflight, no model); S2C-S2B effects at correction-dominated frames are attributed to 'Stage 1 incl. endpoint correction'

judgment_rule.BLOCKED: a prerequisite failed: preflight not OK, declaration/instrument/committed-blob/preflight/controls binding, a negative control not failing closed, K0 primary, eps identity / sampler-call / recorded-state gates of the PRIMARY runs (K0B, K0C, S2B, S2B_rep, S2A, S2C), x1 official/offline/BRIDGE_LEAK gates, or any mechanical contract gate of S2A/S2B/S2C (footprint, Action census, rig validity, hard pin, reversibility, bridge roundtrip, projection consistency), integrity after the run, native-rate videos
judgment_rule.NOT_YET_SUPPORTED: prerequisites OK but learned_path is false (no learned Stage-1 information path beyond passive carry-through)
judgment_rule.PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: learned_path true but METRIC_SUPERIORITY false, OR METRIC_SUPERIORITY true without a human native-rate review (sub-label METRIC_SUPERIORITY_INDICATED; perceptual acceptance PENDING)
judgment_rule.SUPPORTED: learned_path AND METRIC_SUPERIORITY AND a human native-rate review (not available in this batch)
judgment_rule.human_review: hard-coded false in assess for this batch (no human native-rate review is planned): SUPPORTED is unattainable
judgment_rule.native_control: run AFTER the primary result is written, isolated (its failure is recorded as FAILED); status INFORMATIVE / CONTROL_UNINFORMATIVE (admissibility) / INVALID (noise independence, sampler or state gates); reported separately; it scopes the interpretation (Stage-2 capability) and never by itself changes the judgment
judgment_rule.scope: any judgment applies ONLY to MotionBricks(W129, frozen) -> this bridge -> UniMate v3 through the NON-OFFICIAL scheduled-replacement sampler at t_s = 0.5 (no t_s sweep), one clip (S1), one seed; not to UniMate's official modes and not to the general Two-Stage architecture

Thresholds set after seeing only frozen historical branches, never any W139 output
quality_rule.non_inferiority: every arm-local wrist/elbow entry, exit, peak step <= 2 x W129 B's + 10 mm (Q1/Q3 form)
quality_rule.superiority: S2C metric-superior to X in {S2A, S2B, D, W129 B} iff S2C acceptable AND (X not acceptable OR S2C fidelity_proxy <= X's - 20.0 mm); METRIC_SUPERIORITY iff superior to all four
quality_rule.usability_floor: arm-local wrist (W129 armlocal_quality) and elbow (W135 elbow_metrics) peak steps (which include entry 171->172 and exit 199->200) <= 100.0 mm, zero wrist and elbow reversal flicks, no near-straight (>175 deg) or hinge-opposite interior frame
